The '''Falleen bladed-trident''' was a melee weapon of [[Falleen/Legends|Falleen]] origins. When he was training under [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] to become an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]], the future [[Kaarenth Impaler]] [[Ennix Devian]] wielded a Falleen bladed-trident.
